newsitem.title: INDIA: India's SEBI announces norms for custodians.
newsitem.headline: India's SEBI announces norms for custodians.

text.p: India's market regulator on Thursday announced new norms for custodians in the stock markets, bringing them under a regulatory framework, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.

The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) said that under the new norms, the custodians have to become members of clearing houses of stock exchanges within October and participate in clearing and settlement of shares.
The custodians should adopt uniform norms for delivery of shares and integrate with the stock markets, the PTI quoted SEBI as saying.
